metadata.title: Risk Intelligence Report for Think Tank 3: Quality & Risk Management
metadata.purpose: Comprehensive risk intel for planning risk mitigation, quality gates, and contingencies across 5 sessions

critical_bugs.risk: Work results silently lost. Another process can reclaim and reassign work between auth check and completion UPDATE.
critical_bugs.fix: BEGIN IMMEDIATE + WHERE claimed_by=? AND status='claimed' + rowcount check

critical_bugs.risk: Two non-atomic UPDATEs leave inconsistent state on crash. Help request fulfilled but work item not completed, or vice versa.
critical_bugs.fix: BEGIN IMMEDIATE wrapping both UPDATEs + WHERE status='accepted' AND accepted_by_team=? guard

high_severity_bugs.risk: Two agents start same pipeline stage
Completed stage can overwrite failed status
Double invocation from signal handler + main thread

section_2_toctou_bug_catalog.risk_assessment: Critical bugs (WS-001, HP-001) can cause silent data loss in multi-agent coordination. For single-agent market research execution, these are NOT blocking. For multi-agent sessions with work stealing or help protocol, they ARE blocking.

toctou_test_coverage.test_approach: Stress tests with threading.Barrier to maximize contention. 12-25 threads per test, 5 rounds each.

test_classes.asserts: all joins reflected, no lost joins, no duplicates
all leaves reflected, only creator remains

section_3_test_infrastructure.coverage_gaps: No tests for the remaining 18 unfixed TOCTOU bugs. No integration tests. No acceptance tests. No cross-process tests (only in-process threading tests).
section_3_test_infrastructure.risk_for_think_tank: Tests validate the 4 fixed bugs but provide no safety net for unfixed bugs. Any fix to remaining bugs needs NEW tests written following the same barrier pattern.

core_rules.AR-01: Minimum 60% agent capacity on domain work
core_rules.AR-02: Maximum 30% on infrastructure (hard cap: 3 infra agents max)

infrastructure_freeze.FREEZE-01: No new SOPs unless genuinely novel failure mode encountered
infrastructure_freeze.FREEZE-02: No new coordination modules unless blocking a domain task
infrastructure_freeze.FREEZE-03: Bug fixes to existing infrastructure always allowed
infrastructure_freeze.FREEZE-04: Performance improvements require evidence of bottleneck

recursion_warning_signs: Session log with zero domain artifacts
section_4_anti_recursion_protocol.risk_for_think_tank: This think tank IS analyzing coordination/infrastructure. Must ensure recommendations produce domain-enabling outcomes, not more infrastructure. Quality gates for market picks = domain work. Quality gates for coordination system = infrastructure recursion risk.

agent_crash.recovery: Deregister -> backup partial output -> relaunch with context
agent_crash.if_repeated: Split task, check for infinite loops, assign to different team

sqlite_lock_contention.recovery: Force WAL checkpoint -> increase busy_timeout -> retry with backoff -> add jitter
sqlite_lock_contention.emergency: Stop all agents, checkpoint, integrity check, staggered restart

bus_file_corruption.detection: JSON parse errors on bus read
bus_file_corruption.recovery: repair_bus_file() -> manual repair -> backup and recreate -> notify teams

coordinator_failure.recovery: Backup DB -> integrity check -> restart hub -> verify reconnection
coordinator_failure.if_state_lost: Recreate DB, re-register from bus history

network_resource.strategy: Exponential backoff with jitter (base 1s, max 60s, 5 retries)
network_resource.circuit_breaker: 5 consecutive failures -> mark down for 5 min -> probe -> extend to 15 min if still down

workflow_steps: Read and understand full bug report
Identify root cause via code tracing
Document root cause analysis BEFORE coding
Write regression test (must fail without fix, pass with fix)
Run specific test + full test suite
key_rules: Fix all critical before starting high, all high before medium
If multiple at same severity, fix most blocking first
Do not refactor surrounding code in same fix
If test fails, investigate if related to fix or pre-existing
quality_gates_for_bug_fixes: Root cause documented before code change
Fix summary documented with bug_id, severity, root_cause, files_modified, tests_added

key_frameworks.description: Structured approach using measurable data and statistical methods to evaluate risks by likelihood and impact

key_frameworks.description: MSCI framework: (1) compile position and market data, (2) apply methodologies including stress testing, (3) summarize portfolio risks concisely
key_frameworks.applicability: Structure pick reviews around data compilation, stress scenario analysis, and summary reporting.

key_frameworks.applicability: Borrow transparency and documentation requirements for pick justification.

stock_pick_validation_checklist.expert_methodology: Value investing superinvestors (Buffett, Munger, Pabrai, Spier) use checklist approach. Like airline pilots during takeoff, quality-driven investors use checklists for due diligence.

qualitative.business_clarity: Can you describe what the company does in one sentence?

validation_quality_gates: Gate 1: Can I describe the business in one sentence?
Gate 2: Does it pass profitability thresholds (ROCE >= 15%, FCF yield >= 2%)?
Gate 3: Is the company financially healthy (EPS growth, reasonable debt)?
Gate 4: Does it have a durable competitive moat?
Gate 6: Are there clear growth catalysts?
Gate 7: Is the valuation reasonable relative to intrinsic value?
Gate 8: Have I identified and assessed key risks?

key_pitfalls: Survivorship bias: Only including currently active stocks inflates returns
Overfitting/data snooping: Repeated parameter adjustments transform test into training data
Unrealistic costs: Ignoring commissions, bid-ask spreads, slippage
Insufficient sample: Need 100-200+ trades for statistical significance
best_practices: Walk-forward testing: Optimize on in-sample, test on out-of-sample (gold standard)
Realistic transaction costs: Include commissions, spreads, slippage
Separate validation data: Untouched dataset for final validation
Cross-check data sources: Verify data across multiple sources before trusting results
Disclose number of trials and methodology used
backtesting_methodology.applicability_to_our_picks: With zero picks logged, backtesting is not yet applicable. However, establishing a performance tracking framework NOW (entry price, date, thesis, confidence) enables future backtesting. The pick_logger tool (TB-003) is essential for this.

contingency_plans.if_picks_fail_quality_gates: Reduce scope to 1-2 high-conviction picks. Apply full 8-gate checklist. Better 1 quality pick than 5 poor ones.
contingency_plans.if_api_rate_limits_hit: Fall back to WebSearch/WebFetch. Use cached data. Stagger requests with exponential backoff per SOP-021.
contingency_plans.if_critical_bug_causes_data_loss: Stop multi-agent ops. Switch to single-agent mode. Apply SOP-021 recovery. Fix bug before resuming multi-agent.
contingency_plans.if_infrastructure_recursion_detected: Immediate stop. Apply SOP-023 warning sign checklist. Redirect agents to domain work. Document the drift in session log.
contingency_plans.if_market_data_stale_or_wrong: Cross-reference with 2+ additional sources. Flag uncertainty in pick documentation. Reduce confidence score.
contingency_plans.if_team_efficiency_drops: Reduce team size per SOP-022. Reassign to solo tasks. Check for blocking dependencies.
